bsc_settlement_governance.settlement_run_lifecycle: Elexon System Prices undergo multi-stage BSC settlement reconciliations (Interim, SF, R1, R2, R3 over ~14 months). Baseline telemetry represents active system prices (priceDerivationCode P/R) at acquisition.
bsc_settlement_governance.settlement_revision_policy: Recurrent rolling window refreshes fetch active settlement state from Elexon Insights API. Retrospective revisions during settlement reconciliation runs will update rolling window historical values if re-queried.
